batch.description: University of Chittagong (CU) A Unit question-bank collection — 2015-2016. 89 questions (Bangla 10, English 15, Physics 22, Chemistry 24, Higher Mathematics 18). Answer status: 59 verified / 30 unverified; this reflects answer-key review status, not an assertion that the question text is flawless. Import QA 2026-11-19: 22 subject labels corrected; cross-batch source IDs made importer-safe; source-conflicted keys remain unverified. This is a historical question-bank collection, not a claim that the pack count equals the official exam quota. the rest carry their best single-source key or no key, flagged per question. Explanations are null throughout (no cleanly alignable source). 5 source-defect question(s) excluded (stem or options exist only as images in the source transcription; listed in the collection audit report). AI-solved keys (2026-11-18, not source-verified): 22. Keyless: 2. QA audit 2026-11-19: see QA_AUDIT_REPORT.md.
